sanctum-2.upside: Real Solana liquid-staking business; the only fresh event is a KCEX listing, a small exchange that won't bring the kind of buying Upbit did on Nov 13.
sanctum-2.cheap: Not cheap: it already ran on the Upbit listing and is now giving that back (-13% this week). Holders get no share of revenue and profit fell in Q3.
sanctum-2.wrongIf: Price falls under $0.045 (pre-Upbit level) or daily trading falls under $500K.
sanctum-2.vsScanner: The scanner scores the KCEX listing and 17x volume as big news; KCEX is minor and the spike looks like churn on a fading move.

sky.upside: A big, revenue-earning stablecoin protocol that buys back its own token; if the illicit-flows story and the stUSDS withdrawal stress fade, the drop could reverse.
sky.cheap: It fell about 24% on Nov 19-20 after a report tied $518M of flows through its swap module to illicit wallets, and lenders hit withdrawal limits in its stUSDS pool. That is a real reason, not a mispricing.
sky.wrongIf: USDS supply keeps shrinking below $5B, or any regulator or exchange acts on the illicit-flows report.
sky.vsScanner: Scanner score is only 6; I agree it's weak, and add that the news is a fresh negative, not an overlooked bargain.

mori-finance-2.upside: A small working Solana options product ($1.7M options volume in October) that just finished its MetaDAO token sale on Nov 9-13.
mori-finance-2.cheap: It isn't: sale price was $0.025 and it now trades near $0.095, about 3.8x in ten days, on a single DEX pool.
mori-finance-2.wrongIf: Options volume doesn't grow past October's $1.7M, or the price falls back under $0.05.
mori-finance-2.vsScanner: Scanner rates the +42% week as momentum; I see a fresh sale that has already multiplied, with no centralized exchange and about $120K a day of trading.

world-of-dypians.upside: Still no dated event found; the price is up 136% since first picked and 28% today with no news I could find.
world-of-dypians.cheap: No verified reason it is mispriced.
world-of-dypians.wrongIf: Volume fades or it fails the scanner safety filters again.
world-of-dypians.vsScanner: Agree with the scanner that it's moving; I can't explain why.

elsa.upside: A working AI trading-assistant app; the price rose 83% this week right through the Nov 20 unlock, so there is real buying.
elsa.cheap: Still far below its January high because most tokens are locked and unlock monthly.
elsa.wrongIf: Price falls below $0.05, or the next monthly unlock knocks it back below where it was before the run.
elsa.vsScanner: The rally has no announced cause, same as the Nov 5 spike; I'd treat it as speculative.

sectorNews.DeFi: DeFi is under pressure: total value locked has fallen sharply through 2026, and November brought a string of hacks (Mercado Bitcoin $40M on Nov 2, Arcus Perps, Initia, Ankr bridge). Sky, the biggest name on today's list, fell about 24% on an illicit-flows report. This hurts small DeFi coins: money is leaving, not rotating in.
sectorNews.Governance: Governance tokens on today's list (Sanctum, Harvest, Sky) all overlap with DeFi and share its weakness. Sky's governance and buyback story didn't stop a 38% four-week slide, so a governance role alone isn't drawing buyers.
sectorNews.Sports & fan tokens: No Chiliz or Socios news in the last 7 days; the last real drivers were the World Cup (ended July 19) and US college launches earlier this year.
